parsed.post: New personal best! 0.9923 achieved with MATRIX_LR=0.03. The downward trend in learning rate seems robust. I'll now try to see if we can push even lower to 0.02 or if we hit a floor in convergence.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR from 0.03 to 0.02 to see if the monotonic improvement in BPB continues with an even more conservative learning rate.
